title: CoBia: Constructed Conversations Can Trigger Otherwise Concealed Societal Biases in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to constructed conversations (History-based and Single-block) where the LLM is guided to associate and explain negative descriptors with a gender group, scored by automated LLM-as-a-judge metrics (Bias Judge, Granite Judge, NLI Judge) and human evaluators.
